environment.description: Same application deployed in ECS Fargate behind an internal ALB. PostgreSQL connection uses a dedicated role 'ro_catalog_svc' provisioned via Terraform aws_db_instance parameter group with pg_hba.conf restricting this role. The role was created with: CREATE ROLE ro_catalog_svc LOGIN PASSWORD '...' NOSUPERUSER NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE; followed by schema-level grants managed by a separate IAM-authenticated admin session. The effective permission set for ro_catalog_svc on the public.products relation is limited to column-level SELECT on (id, name, price, description, in_stock, category) with no table-level INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, or TRUNCATE privileges. RDS IAM authentication is NOT used for this role (password auth via Secrets Manager rotation). The ALB target group health check path is /graphql?query={__typename} and the service mesh (AWS App Mesh) envoy sidecar handles mTLS between services but does not inspect GraphQL operation types.

config.db_grants: GRANT SELECT (id, name, price, description, in_stock, category) ON public.products TO ro_catalog_svc; -- no other grants
config.db_default_privileges: ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA public REVOKE ALL ON TABLES FROM ro_catalog_svc;
config.network: ALB internal, security group allows 4000/tcp only from ALB SG
config.service_mesh: AWS App Mesh with mTLS, no L7 GraphQL inspection
config.secrets: AWS Secrets Manager with 30-day rotation for ro_catalog_svc password
config.auth: Service-to-service via mTLS (no end-user auth on GraphQL resolvers)
